Replace mode (default): find a unique string and replace it.
Patch mode: apply V4A multi-file patches for bulk changes.

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences instead of requiring a unique match (default: false)

 context line

function.name: terminal
function.description:
Execute shell commands on a Linux environment. Filesystem usually persists between calls.

Do NOT use cat/head/tail to read files — use read_file instead.
Do NOT use grep/rg/find to search — use search_files instead.
Do NOT use ls to list directories — use search_files(target='files') instead.
Do NOT use sed/awk to edit files — use patch instead.
Do NOT use echo/cat heredoc to create files — use write_file instead.
Reserve terminal for: builds, installs, git, processes, scripts, network, package managers, and anything that needs a shell.

Foreground (default): Commands return INSTANTLY when done, even if the timeout is high. Set timeout=300 for long builds/scripts — you'll still get the result in seconds if it's fast. Prefer foreground for short commands.
Background: Set background=true to get a session_id. Two patterns:
  (1) Long-lived processes that never exit (servers, watchers).
  (2) Long-running tasks with notify_on_complete=true — you can keep working on other things and the system auto-notifies you when the task finishes. Great for test suites, builds, deployments, or anything that takes more than a minute.
For servers/watchers, do NOT use shell-level background wrappers (nohup/disown/setsid/trailing '&') in foreground mode. Use background=true so Hermes can track lifecycle and output.
After starting a server, verify readiness with a health check or log signal, then run tests in a separate terminal() call. Avoid blind sleep loops.
Use process(action="poll") for progress checks, process(action="wait") to block until done.
Working directory: Use 'workdir' for per-command cwd.
PTY mode: Set pty=true for interactive CLI tools (Codex, Claude Code, Python REPL).

Do NOT use vim/nano/interactive tools without pty=true — they hang without a pseudo-terminal. Pipe git output to cat if it might page.

command.description: The command to execute on the VM

background.description: Run the command in the background. Two patterns: (1) Long-lived processes that never exit (servers, watchers). (2) Long-running tasks paired with notify_on_complete=true — you can keep working and get notified when the task finishes. For short commands, prefer foreground with a generous timeout instead.

timeout.description: Max seconds to wait (default: 180, foreground max: 600). Returns INSTANTLY when command finishes — set high for long tasks, you won't wait unnecessarily. Foreground timeout above 600s is rejected; use background=true for longer commands.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command (absolute path). Defaults to the session working directory.

pty.description: Run in pseudo-terminal (PTY) mode for interactive CLI tools like Codex, Claude Code, or Python REPL. Only works with local and SSH backends. Default: false.

notify_on_complete.description: When true (and background=true), you'll be automatically notified exactly once when the process finishes. **This is the right choice for almost every long-running task** — tests, builds, deployments, multi-item batch jobs, anything that takes over a minute and has a defined end. Use this and keep working on other things; the system notifies you on exit. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with watch_patterns — when both are set, watch_patterns is dropped.

watch_patterns.description: Strings to watch for in background process output. HARD RATE LIMIT: at most 1 notification per 15 seconds per process — matches arriving inside the cooldown are dropped. After 3 consecutive 15-second windows with dropped matches, watch_patterns is automatically disabled for that process and promoted to notify_on_complete behavior (one notification on exit, no more mid-process spam). USE ONLY for truly rare, one-shot mid-process signals on LONG-LIVED processes that will never exit on their own — e.g. ['Application startup complete'] on a server so you know when to hit its endpoint, or ['migration done'] on a daemon. DO NOT use for: (1) end-of-run markers like 'DONE'/'PASS' — use notify_on_complete instead; (2) error patterns like 'ERROR'/'Traceback' in loops or multi-item batch jobs — they fire on every iteration and you'll hit the strike limit fast; (3) anything you'd ever combine with notify_on_complete. When in doubt, choose notify_on_complete. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with notify_on_complete — set one, not both.

{"content": "     1|#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2|"""
     3|route_outcomes — SQLite 存储层
     4|每个 trace 记录对应 L0 一次 skill 执行的结果，被 L1 hook 写入、L2 router 读取。
     5|
     6|Schema:
     7|  CREATE TABLE route_outcomes (
     8|    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
     9|    ts          TEXT NOT NULL,           -- ISO 8601
    10|    skill       TEXT NOT NULL,           -- 执行的 skill 名
    11|    task_class  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',-- task 分类 (triage 输出)
    12|    route       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',-- 路由路径
    13|    verdict     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', -- pass / fail / partial
    14|    duration_s  REAL DEFAULT 0,

    32|import sqlite3, os, json, datetime, sys

    35|DB_PATH = os.path.expanduser("~/.hermes/route_outcomes.db")

    38|class RouteStore:
    39|    """thread-safe 的单写多读存储 (WAL mode)"""
    40|
    41|    def __init__(self, db_path=None):
    42|        self.path = db_path or DB_PATH
    43|        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(self.path), exist_ok=True)

    50|    def _ensure_schema(self):
    51|        self._conn.executescript("""
    52|            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS route_outcomes (
    53|                id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    54|                ts          TEXT NOT NULL,
    55|                skill       TEXT NOT NULL,
    56|                task_class  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    57|                route       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

    59|                duration_s  REAL DEFAULT 0,
    60|                tokens_in   INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    61|                tokens_out  INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    62|                task_id     TEXT DEFAULT '',

    65|                error       TEXT DEFAULT '',
    66|                is_synthetic INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    67|            );
    68|            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ro_ts ON route_outcomes(ts);
    69|            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ro_class ON route_outcomes(task_class);
    70|            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ro_skill ON route_outcomes(skill);
    71|            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ro_verdict ON route_outcomes(verdict);
    72|        """)
    73|
    74|    def append(self, skill="", task_class="", route="", verdict="unknown",
    75|               duration_s=0, tokens_in=0, tokens_out=0, task_id="",
    76|               model_chain="", cost_usd=0, error="", is_synthetic=0):
    77|        """写入一条 trace"""
    78|        if isinstance(model_chain, (list, tuple)):
    79|            model_chain = json.dumps(model_chain)
    80|        self._conn.execute(
    81|            """INSERT INTO route_outcomes
    82|               (ts, skill, task_class, route, verdict, duration_s,
    83|                tokens_in, tokens_out, task_id, model_chain, cost_usd, error, is_synthetic)
    84|               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
    85|            (datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%FT%TZ"),
    86|             skill, task_class, route, verdict, duration_s,
    87|             tokens_in, tokens_out, task_id, model_chain, cost_usd, error, is_synthetic)
    88|        )
    89|        self._conn.commit()
    90|        cursor = self._conn.execute("SELECT last_insert_rowid()")
    91|        return cursor.fetchone()[0]
    92|
    93|    def append_from_stdin(self):
    94|        """从 stdin JSON 读取并写入（给 shell hook 用）"""

    96|        self.append(
    97|            skill=payload.get("skill", ""),
    98|            task_class=payload.get("task_class", ""),
    99|            route=payload.get("route", ""),
   100|            verdict=payload.get("verdict", "unknown"),
   101|            duration_s=payload.get("duration_s", 0),
   102|            tokens_in=payload.get("tokens_in", 0),
   103|            tokens_out=payload.get("tokens_out", 0),
   104|            task_id=payload.get("task_id", ""),
   105|            model_chain=payload.get("model_chain", ""),
   106|            cost_usd=payload.get("cost_usd", 0),
   107|            error=payload.get("error", ""),
   108|            is_synthetic=payload.get("is_synthetic", 0),
   109|        )
   110|
   111|    def query(self, task_class=None, skill=None, verdict=None,
   112|              limit=50, offset=0, since_hours=0):
   113|        """查询路由结果"""
   114|        where = []
   115|        params = []
   116|        if task_class:
   117|            where.append("task_class = ?")
   118|            params.append(task_class)
   119|        if skill:
   120|            where.append("skill = ?")
   121|            params.append(skill)
   122|        if verdict:
   123|            where.append("verdict = ?")
   124|            params.append(verdict)
   125|        if since_hours > 0:
   126|            cutoff = (datetime.datetime.utcnow() -
   127|                      datetime.timedelta(hours=since_hours))
   128|            where.append("ts >= ?")
   129|            params.append(cutoff.strftime("%FT%TZ"))
   130|        sql = "SELECT * FROM route_outcomes"
   131|        if where:
   132|            sql += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(where)
   133|        sql += " ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?"
   134|        params.extend([limit, offset])
   135|        rows = self._conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall()
   136|        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
   137|
   138|    def stats(self, task_class=None, skill=None, since_hours=168):
   139|        """聚合统计：pass_rate, avg_duration, avg_cost, p50/p95"""
   140|        where = []
   141|        params = []
   142|        if task_class:
   143|            where.append("task_class = ?")
   144|            params.append(task_class)
   145|        if skill:
   146|            where.append("skill = ?")
   147|            params.append(skill)
   148|        if since_hours > 0:
   149|            cutoff = (datetime.datetime.utcnow() -
   150|                      datetime.timedelta(hours=since_hours))
   151|            where.append("ts >= ?")
   152|            params.append(cutoff.strftime("%FT%TZ"))
   153|        w = (" WHERE " + " AND ".join(where)) if where else ""
   154|
   155|        # pass_rate + averages
   156|        row = self._conn.execute(f"""
   157|            SELECT
   158|                COUNT(*) as total,
   159|                SUM(CASE WHEN verdict='pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as passed,
   160|                SUM(CASE WHEN verdict='fail' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed,
   161|                ROUND(AVG(duration_s), 1) as avg_duration,
   162|                ROUND(AVG(cost_usd), 4) as avg_cost
   163|            FROM route_outcomes{w}
   164|        """, params).fetchone()
   165|        result = dict(row) if row else {"total": 0, "passed": 0, "failed": 0}
   166|
   167|        # 按 route 分组统计
   168|        route_rows = self._conn.execute(f"""
   169|            SELECT
   170|                route, COUNT(*) as cnt,
   171|                SUM(CASE WHEN verdict='pass' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as passed,
   172|                ROUND(AVG(duration_s), 1) as avg_dur,
   173|                ROUND(AVG(cost_usd), 4) as avg_cost
   174|            FROM route_outcomes{w}
   175|            GROUP BY route ORDER BY cnt DESC
   176|        """, params).fetchall()
   177|        result["routes"] = [dict(r) for r in route_rows]
   178|
   179|        # synthetic/real split
   180|        synth_row = self._conn.execute(f"""
   181|            SELECT
   182|                SUM(CASE WHEN is_synthetic=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as synthetic,
   183|                SUM(CASE WHEN is_synthetic=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as real
   184|            FROM route_outcomes{w}
   185|        """, params).fetchone()
   186|        if synth_row:

   188|            result["real"] = synth_row["real"] or 0
   189|
   190|        if result["total"] > 0:
   191|            result["pass_rate"] = round(result["passed"] / result["total"], 3)
   192|        else:
   193|            result["pass_rate"] = 0.0
   194|
   195|        return result
   196|
   197|    def route_scores(self, task_class=None, since_hours=168,
   198|                     lambda_cost=0.1, lambda_time=0.01):

   200|           score = pass_rate - lambda_cost * avg_cost - lambda_time * avg_duration
   201|        """

   203|        scored = []

   206|            score = (pass_rate
   207|                     - lambda_cost * r.get("avg_cost", 0)
   208|                     - lambda_time * r.get("avg_dur", 0) / 60)
   209|            scored.append({

   213|                "avg_dur": r["avg_dur"],
   214|                "avg_cost": r["avg_cost"],
   215|                "score": round(score, 4),
   216|            })
   217|        scored.sort(key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)
   218|        return scored
   219|
   220|    def summary(self, since_hours=168):
   221|        """系统总览摘要"""
   222|        stats = self.stats(since_hours=since_hours)
   223|        total = stats.get("total", 0)
   224|        real_total = stats.get("real", 0)
   225|        synth_total = stats.get("synthetic", 0)
   226|        lines = [

   229|            f"  Real: {real_total} traces | Synthetic: {synth_total} traces",

   232|        ]

   234|            pr = r["passed"] / max(r["cnt"], 1)
   235|            lines.append(f"  route={r['route']}: {r['cnt']}x pass={pr:.0%} dur={r['avg_dur']:.0f}s")
   236|        return "\n".join(lines)
   237|
   238|    def close(self):
   239|        self._conn.close()

{"content": "     1|#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2|# canary-evaluator.sh — L5 灰度评估 (24h 后比对 canary vs stable)
     3|# 每小时跑一次, 但只处理 canary-active.txt 中有记录的 skill
     4|#
     5|# canary 的 skill 在 canary-active.txt 中:
     6|#   skill_name 启用时间(unix_ts)  描述
     7|# 如:
     8|#   router 1745712000 "自进化管线router skill v2"
     9|#
    10|# 24h 后自动决定: pass_rate 不降 → promote; 下降 → rollback
    11|set -euo pipefail
    12|
    13|CANARY_FILE=~/.hermes/canary-active.txt
    14|EVOLVE_LOG=~/.hermes/logs/evolve.log
    15|NOW=$(date +%s)
    16|mkdir -p "$(dirname "$CANARY_FILE")"
    17|touch "$CANARY_FILE"
    18|
    19|evaluate_canary() {
    20|    local skill="$1" started_at="$2" desc="$3"
    21|    local age=$(( (NOW - started_at) / 3600 ))
    22|    echo "[canary] $skill: age=${age}h (needs 24h)" >&2
    23|    [ "$age" -lt 24 ] && return 0  # 没到 24h, 跳过
    24|
    25|    # 取 canary 版本的 pass_rate (sklls-staging 或 canary 分支)
    26|    local canary_pr=0 stable_pr=0
    27|
    28|    # 稳定版: 从 route_outcomes 取 7d 该 skill 的 pass_rate
    29|    stable_pr=$(python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/route_store.py stats \
    30|        --skill "$skill" --hours 168 2>/dev/null | \
    31|        python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('pass_rate',0))" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    32|
    33|    # 灰度版: 从 canary 标记的 outcomes 取 (有 canary=true 字段)
    34|    # 当前 route_outcomes 没有 canary 标记, 用最近 24h 该 skill 的数据近似
    35|    canary_pr=$(python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/route_store.py stats \
    36|        --skill "$skill" --hours 24 2>/dev/null | \
    37|        python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('pass_rate',0))" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    38|
    39|    echo "[canary] $skill: stable=$stable_pr canary=$canary_pr" >&2
    40|
    41|    # 决策
    42|    local delta
    43|    delta=$(python3 -c "print($canary_pr - $stable_pr)" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    44|
    45|    if python3 -c "exit(0 if float('$delta') < -0.05 else 1)" 2>/dev/null; then
    46|        # 回滚
    47|        echo "[canary] ⛔ $skill canary regressed (delta=$delta). Rolling back."
    48|        local staging="$HOME/.hermes/skills-staging/$skill"
    49|        rm -rf "$staging" 2>/dev/null
    50|        # 清除 canary 配置
    51|        hermes config set "skills.$skill.canary_ratio" 0.0 2>/dev/null || true
    52|        # 从 canary-active 移除
    53|        grep -v "^$skill " "$CANARY_FILE" > /tmp/canary.tmp
    54|        mv /tmp/canary.tmp "$CANARY_FILE"
    55|
    56|        local entry="{\"ts\":\"$(date -u +%FT%TZ)\",\"event\":\"canary_reject\",\"skill\":\"$skill\",\"desc\":\"$desc\",\"reason\":\"regression\",\"delta\":$delta}"
    57|        echo "$entry" >> "$EVOLVE_LOG"
    58|    elif python3 -c "exit(0 if float('$delta') >= 0 else 1)" 2>/dev/null; then
    59|        # 100% rollout
    60|        echo "[canary] ✅ $skill canary passes (delta=$delta). Promoting to 100%."
    61|        hermes config set "skills.$skill.canary_ratio" 1.0 2>/dev/null || true
    62|        # 从 staging promote 到 production
    63|        local staging="$HOME/.hermes/skills-staging/$skill"
    64|        local prod
    65|        prod=$(find "$HOME/.hermes/skills" -name "SKILL.md" -path "*/$skill/*" 2>/dev/null)
    66|        if [ -n "$prod" ] && [ -d "$staging" ]; then
    67|            cp "$staging/SKILL.md" "$prod"
    68|            rm -rf "$staging"
    69|        fi
    70|        # 从 canary-active 移除
    71|        grep -v "^$skill " "$CANARY_FILE" > /tmp/canary.tmp
    72|        mv /tmp/canary.tmp "$CANARY_FILE"
    73|
    74|        local entry="{\"ts\":\"$(date -u +%FT%TZ)\",\"event\":\"canary_promote\",\"skill\":\"$skill\",\"desc\":\"$desc\",\"delta\":$delta}"
    75|        echo "$entry" >> "$EVOLVE_LOG"
    76|    else
    77|        echo "[canary] ⏸️  $skill: delta=$delta, within threshold. Keeping canary 24h more."
    78|    fi
    79|}
    80|
    81|main() {
    82|    if [ ! -s "$CANARY_FILE" ]; then
    83|        echo "[canary] No active canaries."
    84|        exit 0
    85|    fi
    86|
    87|    local changes=0
    88|    while IFS=' ' read -r skill started desc; do
    89|        [ -z "$skill" ] && continue
    90|        evaluate_canary "$skill" "$started" "$desc"
    91|        changes=1
    92|    done < "$CANARY_FILE"
    93|
    94|    [ "$changes" -eq 0 ] && echo "[canary] No active canaries (empty file)."
    95|}
    96|
    97|main

     2|"""
     3|Agent 健康度监控脚本 — 基于钱学森工程控制论的李雅普诺夫函数
     4|
     5|计算 V(x) = 0.30*成功率 + 0.25*满意度 + 0.20*skill覆盖率 + 0.15*构建通过率 + 0.10*迭代效率
     6|保存历史，计算 V̇，触发告警。
     7|
     8|保存路径: ~/.hermes/notes/engineering-cybernetics/health-history.jsonl
     9|"""
    10|
    11|import json, os, sys, subprocess, re
    12|from datetime import datetime, timedelta
    13|
    14|HOME = os.path.expanduser("~")
    15|BASE = os.path.join(HOME, ".hermes", "notes", "engineering-cybernetics")
    16|HISTORY_FILE = os.path.join(BASE, "health-history.jsonl")
    17|
    18|os.makedirs(BASE, exist_ok=True)
    19|
    20|# ===================== 数据采集 =====================
    21|
    22|def collect_success_rate():
    23|    """从 builder-journal 和 feedback 统计成功率"""
    24|    success = 0
    25|    total = 0
    26|    
    27|    # 读取 feedback
    28|    fb_path = os.path.join(HOME, ".pua", "feedback.jsonl")
    29|    if os.path.exists(fb_path):
    30|        with open(fb_path) as f:
    31|            for line in f:
    32|                line = line.strip()
    33|                if not line:
    34|                    continue
    35|                try:
    36|                    obj = json.loads(line)
    37|                    total += 1
    38|                    # rating 为"很有用"或没有明确负面标记视为成功
    39|                    r = obj.get("rating", "")
    40|                    if "有用" in r or "good" in r.lower() or r == "":
    41|                        success += 1
    42|                except:
    43|                    pass
    44|    
    45|    # 读取 builder-journal 中的 failure_count
    46|    bj_path = os.path.join(HOME, ".pua", "builder-journal.md")
    47|    recent_failures = 0
    48|    recent_total = 0
    49|    if os.path.exists(bj_path):
    50|        with open(bj_path) as f:
    51|            content = f.read()
    52|        # 简单启发：查找 failure_count
    53|        m = re.search(r'failure_count[:\s]+(\d+)', content)
    54|        if m:
    55|            recent_failures = int(m.group(1))
    56|            recent_total = max(recent_total, recent_failures + 1)
    57|    
    58|    if total == 0 and recent_total == 0:
    59|        return 0.85  # 默认基线
    60|    
    61|    if total > 0:
    62|        return success / total
    63|    return max(0.5, 1 - recent_failures / max(recent_total, 1))
    64|
    65|def collect_satisfaction():
    66|    """用户满意度 ≈ 1 - 纠正频率"""
    67|    # 从 feedback 中推断
    68|    fb_path = os.path.join(HOME, ".pua", "feedback.jsonl")
    69|    good = 0
    70|    total = 0
    71|    if os.path.exists(fb_path):
    72|        with open(fb_path) as f:
    73|            for line in f:
    74|                line = line.strip()
    75|                if not line:
    76|                    continue
    77|                try:
    78|                    obj = json.loads(line)
    79|                    total += 1
    80|                    r = obj.get("rating", "")
    81|                    if "有用" in r or "good" in r.lower():
    82|                        good += 1
    83|                except:
    84|                    pass
    85|    if total == 0:
    86|        return 0.80
    87|    return good / total
    88|
    89|def collect_skill_coverage():
    90|    """skill 覆盖率 ≈ 已安装 skill 数 / 目标 skill 数"""
    91|    skills_dir = os.path.join(HOME, ".hermes", "skills")
    92|    if not os.path.exists(skills_dir):
    93|        return 0.5
    94|    
    95|    # 统计所有子目录下的 SKILL.md
    96|    count = 0
    97|    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(skills_dir):
    98|        if "SKILL.md" in files:
    99|            count += 1
   100|    
   101|    # 目标 skill 数（根据当前工作流估算）
   102|    target = 35  # 当前已有 + 规划中
   103|    return min(1.0, count / target)
   104|
   105|def collect_build_pass_rate():
   106|    """构建通过率 — 从最近 git log 推断"""
   107|    try:
   108|        result = subprocess.run(
   109|            ["git", "log", "--oneline", "-20"],
   110|            capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=os.path.join(HOME, "Desktop", "folder")
   111|        )
   112|        if result.returncode != 0:
   113|            # 尝试其他路径
   114|            result = subprocess.run(
   115|                ["git", "log", "--oneline", "-20"],
   116|                capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=HOME
   117|            )
   118|    except:
   119|        result = None
   120|    
   121|    if result is None or result.returncode != 0:
   122|        return 0.90
   123|    
   124|    lines = [l for l in result.stdout.strip().split("\n") if l.strip()]
   125|    if not lines:
   126|        return 0.90
   127|    
   128|    total = len(lines)
   129|    # [verified] 前缀表示通过独立审查
   130|    verified = sum(1 for l in lines if "[verified]" in l.lower() or "verified" in l.lower())
   131|    # fix 开头可能表示修复了失败
   132|    fixes = sum(1 for l in lines if l.lower().startswith("fix") or "fix:" in l.lower())
   133|    
   134|    # 简单估计：verified 算通过，fix 算曾经失败
   135|    pass_rate = (total - fixes * 0.5) / total
   136|    return max(0.5, min(1.0, pass_rate))
   137|
   138|def collect_iteration_efficiency():
   139|    """迭代效率 ≈ 1 / 平均轮次"""
   140|    # 从 builder-journal 读取 pressure_level 和 iteration 信息
   141|    bj_path = os.path.join(HOME, ".pua", "builder-journal.md")
   142|    if not os.path.exists(bj_path):
   143|        return 0.70  # 默认 1/1.4 轮次
   144|    
   145|    with open(bj_path) as f:
   146|        content = f.read()
   147|    
   148|    # 查找 iteration 或 pua_triggered_count 作为代理指标
   149|    m = re.search(r'pua_triggered_count[:\s]+(\d+)', content)
   150|    if m:
   151|        triggers = int(m.group(1))
   152|        # 触发次数多 = 效率低（需要更多轮次修正）
   153|        # 映射：0 触发 -> 1.0, 10+ 触发 -> 0.3
   154|        eff = max(0.3, 1.0 - triggers * 0.07)
   155|        return eff
   156|    
   157|    return 0.70
   158|
   159|# ===================== V 计算 =====================
   160|
   161|def calculate_health():
   162|    r_success = collect_success_rate()
   163|    r_satisfaction = collect_satisfaction()
   164|    r_coverage = collect_skill_coverage()
   165|    r_build = collect_build_pass_rate()
   166|    r_efficiency = collect_iteration_efficiency()
   167|    
   168|    V = (0.30 * r_success +
   169|         0.25 * r_satisfaction +
   170|         0.20 * r_coverage +
   171|         0.15 * r_build +
   172|         0.10 * r_efficiency)
   173|    
   174|    return {
   175|        "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
   176|        "V": round(V, 4),
   177|        "components": {
   178|            "success_rate": round(r_success, 4),
   179|            "satisfaction": round(r_satisfaction, 4),
   180|            "skill_coverage": round(r_coverage, 4),
   181|            "build_pass_rate": round(r_build, 4),
   182|            "iteration_efficiency": round(r_efficiency, 4)
   183|        }
   184|    }
   185|
   186|def load_history(limit=30):
   187|    if not os.path.exists(HISTORY_FILE):
   188|        return []
   189|    history = []
   190|    with open(HISTORY_FILE) as f:
   191|        for line in f:
   192|            line = line.strip()
   193|            if not line:
   194|                continue
   195|            try:
   196|                history.append(json.loads(line))
   197|            except:
   198|                pass
   199|    return history[-limit:]
   200|
   201|def save_record(record):
   202|    with open(HISTORY_FILE, "a") as f:
   203|        f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
   204|
   205|def compute_vdot(history, current):
   206|    if not history:
   207|        return None
   208|    prev = history[-1]
   209|    try:
   210|        v_prev = prev.get("V", prev.get("v", 0))
   211|        v_curr = current["V"]
   212|        return round(v_curr - v_prev, 4)
   213|    except:
   214|        return None
   215|
   216|def print_banner(text):
   217|    print("=" * 60)
   218|    print(text.center(60))
   219|    print("=" * 60)

{"content": "     1|#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2|# record-trace.sh — L1 观测层 shell hook
     3|# 注册到 ~/.hermes/config.yaml 的 hooks.post_tool_call 执行
     4|# 接收 stdin JSON, 写入 route_outcomes DB
     5|#
     6|# 由 Hermes shell hook 系统自动调用:
     7|#   hooks:
     8|#     post_tool_call:
     9|#       - matcher: "terminal|read_file|write_file|patch|web_search|browser_navigate"
    10|#         command: "~/.hermes/agent-hooks/record-trace.sh"
    11|#         timeout: 5
    12|
    13|PAYLOAD="$(cat -)"
    14|
    15|# 解析关键字段
    16|EVENT=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('hook_event_name',''))" 2>/dev/null)
    17|TOOL=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_name',''))" 2>/dev/null)
    18|TASK_ID=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); e=d.get('extra',{}); print(e.get('task_id','') or e.get('session_id',''))" 2>/dev/null)
    19|
    20|# 只在 post_tool_call 事件时记录
    21|if [ "$EVENT" != "post_tool_call" ] || [ -z "$TOOL" ]; then
    22|  printf '{}\n'
    23|  exit 0
    24|fi
    25|
    26|# 采样: 记录 50% 的工具调用
    27|SAMPLE=$(( RANDOM % 100 ))
    28|if [ "$SAMPLE" -gt 49 ]; then
    29|  printf '{}\n'
    30|  exit 0
    31|fi
    32|
    33|# 构建 trace JSON
    34|RESULT=$(echo "$PAYLOAD" | python3 -c "
    35|import sys, json
    36|d = json.load(sys.stdin)
    37|extra = d.get('extra', {})
    38|result_str = extra.get('result', '')
    39|# 尝试解析 result 判断 verdict
    40|verdict = 'unknown'
    41|error = ''
    42|duration_s = 0
    43|tokens_in = 0
    44|tokens_out = 0
    45|try:
    46|    r = json.loads(result_str)
    47|    if isinstance(r, dict):
    48|        ec = r.get('exit_code')
    49|        if ec is not None:
    50|            verdict = 'pass' if ec == 0 else 'fail'
    51|            if ec != 0:
    52|                error = f'exit_code={ec}'
    53|        err = r.get('error')
    54|        if err and str(err).lower() not in ('null', 'none', ''):
    55|            verdict = 'fail'
    56|            error = str(err)[:200]
    57|        if not ec and not err:
    58|            verdict = 'pass'
    59|except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
    60|    verdict = 'pass'
    61|print(json.dumps({
    62|    'skill': extra.get('tool_name', '') or d.get('tool_name', ''),
    63|    'task_class': '',
    64|    'route': 'hook:' + d.get('tool_name', 'unknown'),
    65|    'verdict': verdict,
    66|    'duration_s': duration_s,
    67|    'tokens_in': tokens_in,
    68|    'tokens_out': tokens_out,
    69|    'task_id': extra.get('task_id', '') or d.get('session_id', ''),
    70|    'error': error,
    71|}))
    72|" 2>/dev/null)
    73|
    74|if [ -n "$RESULT" ]; then
    75|  echo "$RESULT" | python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/route_store.py append --stdin 2>/dev/null
    76|fi
    77|
    78|printf '{}\n'
    79|", "total_lines": 78, "file_size": 2448, "truncated": false, "is_binary": false, "is_image": false}
